$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.2.0-draft (pre-1.0). Mirrors backend/services/api/schemas.py ReportVersion. Immutability is a server rule (BE-10, #33): a published version is never edited; corrections and confirmed full-video expansions create a new version that names the one it supersedes.
title: ReportVersion
description: One immutable published version of an investigation's report: the claims found, the evidence retrieved and the assessments made, plus a change summary describing what differs from the superseded version. Returned nested in an investigation read and, in #33, by GET /v1/investigations/{id}/reports/{version}. An empty claims array with an empty assessments array means no assessable factual claims were found; it is not a statement that the video is accurate.

version.description: 1 for the first published version, then increasing by one. Every nested assessment carries the same number.

provisional.description: True while processing continues (partial results) or coverage is incomplete; false only when the investigation is complete.

change_summary.description: What this version adds or changes relative to supersedes; for version 1, how the report came to be.

supersedes.description: Id of the previous report version, or null for the first.

evidence.description: Every piece of evidence any assessment in this version refers to. Each item names its claim_id.

assessments.description: At most one per claim in this version. Fewer assessments than claims means those claims are still being assessed (provisional) or the investigation stopped before assessing them.

fixture.description: True only for a development stub version built from fixtures/results/complete.json while the server runs with OVRLY_STUB_REPORTS=1 (until the assessment pipeline, #27, exists). Such a version is not a check of the media; clients must label its claims as a fixture, never as live results. Optional for compatibility: an absent value means false. The server always sends it.
